$comment: Measured facts for HPV16 E6 oncogene excision. The AAV vector acts as a targeted drug: it only produces a therapeutic effect in cells containing integrated HPV16 DNA.

subject.therapeutic_effect: p53 tumor suppressor restored in HPV+ cells only
subject.selectivity: HPV- cells unaffected (no target for Cas9 to bind)
subject.model: HPV16+ cervical cancer cell lines (SiHa, CaSki)
subject.efficacy: 70-90% E6 disruption in HPV+ cells, 0% in HPV- cells

facts.note: The sequence IS the drug target. No HPV DNA = no therapeutic action. This is the fundamental selectivity of sequence-directed therapy.

data.note: For E6 disruption, indels are the desired outcome (frameshift kills oncogene function). Unlike reservoir elimination, success here is indel + deleted + degraded = 83%.
